_remarks.file_purpose: Runtime controls for AirSim train/visualize behavior used by fw.main_with_airsim and airsim.train.train_airsim.
_remarks.json_note: JSON does not support comments, so remarks are stored in _remarks blocks.
_remarks.routing_note: fw.config chooses env_type/action; this file refines AirSim behavior once AirSimEnv is selected.
_remarks.merge_note: All keys are merged onto built-in defaults via merge_runtime_settings(); absent keys fall back to code defaults, not JSON zeros.

_remarks.model_visualise: true => run framework-model replay in UE5 via run_visualise_models.
_remarks.model_family: Model family selector for run_visualise_models (auto|pysim|fhsim). 'auto' infers the family from the checkpoint filename.
_remarks.inference_visualise: true => run AirSimEnv inference visualization via run_inference.
_remarks.mode_priority: If both model_visualise and inference_visualise are true, model_visualise wins and inference_visualise is skipped.
_remarks.model_path: Path to the framework .zip policy checkpoint used by run_visualise_models (relative to repo root or absolute).
_remarks.inference_model_path: Path to the AirSim .zip policy used for inference visualization. Ignored when model_visualise is true.
_remarks.environment_name: Framework environment name passed to run_visualise_models. 'auto' lets the model family resolver pick the environment.
_remarks.mirror_controls_in_ue5: true => stream policy control outputs to the UE5 vehicle during model replay.
_remarks.animate_steering_in_ue5: true => play the steering servo animation on the UE5 vehicle during replay.
_remarks.animate_throttle_in_ue5: true => play the throttle animation on the UE5 vehicle during replay.
_remarks.render_interpolation_steps: Intermediate positions interpolated between policy steps when mirroring motion to UE5. Higher values smooth motion but increase visual overhead.
_remarks.steering_visual_gain: Scales mirrored steering output before sending to the UE5 vehicle animation. Calibrate so visual deflection matches policy intent.
_remarks.throttle_visual_gain: Scales mirrored throttle so UE5 visual propulsion matches the framework replay speed envelope. 5.0/5.6 ≈ 0.893 is the calibrated constant for the current ship.
_remarks.use_kinematics_in_ue5: true => drive the UE5 vehicle via the kinematics API instead of car-physics controls during replay.
_remarks.min_render_hz: Minimum render loop rate in Hz; the visualizer throttles to this floor to keep UE5 responsive.
_remarks.max_translation_step: Maximum position delta (metres) per render frame when interpolating UE5 vehicle motion.
_remarks.max_yaw_step_deg: Maximum yaw rotation (degrees) per render frame when interpolating UE5 vehicle heading.
_remarks.vehicle_object_name: UE5 actor name of the vehicle to control. Empty string uses the AirSim default vehicle.
_remarks.lock_path_in_ue5: true => freeze the drawn route path in place so it does not redraw during replay.
_remarks.episodes: Number of replay/inference episodes to run before the visualizer exits.
_remarks.max_steps: Episode step cap for visualization entry points.
_remarks.device: PyTorch device for policy inference during visualization ('cpu' or 'cuda'). Built-in code default is 'cuda'.
_remarks.log_every: Print a step log line every N steps during visualization.
_remarks.draw_calibration_reference: true => draw calibration ridges, route line, and start/end markers during visualization.

_remarks.speed_profile: Named timing preset: normal|safe|fast|turbo|custom. A named profile overwrites simulation_speed, use_pause_stepping, frames_per_step, time_step, physics_update_timeout, and state_poll_interval with preset values. 'custom' leaves all timing keys as written below. 'safe' is recommended for new AirSim runs.
_remarks.simulation_speed: UE5 simulation speed multiplier. Overridden by the active speed_profile when a named profile is selected.
_remarks.draw_calibration_reference: true => draw calibration ridges, route line, and start/end markers during training.
_remarks.no_rendering_mode: true => disable UE5 scene rendering during training while keeping physics active. Reduces GPU load in headless runs.
_remarks.load_world_on_start: true => issue one save-slot world reload at training startup to force the simulator_1 spawn state, then keep all later resets pose-based.
_remarks.capture_live_start_pose: true => after the one-shot startup reload settles, adopt the live simulator spawn pose and heading as the reset anchor for all subsequent respawns.
_remarks.episode_log_path: CSV path for per-step AirSim training telemetry. Relative paths are resolved from the repo root. Empty string disables logging.
_remarks.max_policy_updates: Number of PPO policy updates before the standalone train_airsim stop condition triggers.
_remarks.normalize_reward: true => scale the shaped environment reward into [-1, 1] before PPO consumes it.
_remarks.reward_normalization_scale: Absolute reward scale used for clipping into [-1, 1] when normalize_reward is true.
_remarks.reset_mode: rewind_pose => teleport back to the route start without a full bridge reset. bridge_reset => call the heavier AirSim reset path first.
_remarks.progress_log_interval_steps: Print a concise training heartbeat every N AirSim steps. Set 0 to disable.
_remarks.log_pause_watchdog_warnings: true => print pause watchdog timeout warnings during lock-step training. false keeps training output clean.
_remarks.use_sim_time_stepping: true => advance each RL step by a fixed amount of simulated time via simContinueForTime(). Requires use_pause_stepping.
_remarks.sim_time_per_action: Simulated seconds advanced per RL action when use_sim_time_stepping is true. Also becomes the effective time_step when both pause flags are active.
_remarks.use_pause_stepping: true => deterministic paused stepping. Combine with use_sim_time_stepping for a fixed simulated duration per RL step.
_remarks.frames_per_step: UE5 physics frames advanced per RL step when frame stepping is used (use_pause_stepping true, use_sim_time_stepping false).
_remarks.time_step: Nominal RL step duration in seconds. When use_pause_stepping and use_sim_time_stepping are both true, this is overwritten by sim_time_per_action at runtime.
_remarks.physics_update_timeout: Watchdog timeout in seconds while waiting for frame-step or sim-time-step completion.
_remarks.state_poll_interval: Polling cadence in seconds while waiting for UE5 to re-pause after a step.
_remarks.max_steps: Episode step cap for AirSim training.
_remarks.curriculum_enabled: true => use staged curriculum starts that advance the spawn frontier as the agent improves. false => train directly on the full route from the fixed start pose.
_remarks.control_interface: UE5 control interface contract. Keep 'car_physics' for the current car-based AirSim controls.
_remarks.observation_profile: PPO observation contract. 'ppo_route_relative_car' exposes route-relative position, turn-rate, and cross-track trend cues.
_remarks.guidance_assist_enabled: true => add a residual guidance correction to policy outputs before sending to UE5. false is recommended for PPO training stability.
_remarks.steering_dynamics_enabled: true => apply vessel-like steering dynamics (low-pass filter + slew-rate limit) before controls are sent to UE5.
_remarks.steering_smoothing_alpha: Low-pass blend factor in [0, 1] for steering dynamics. Higher values track policy output faster; lower values are smoother.
_remarks.max_steering_rate_per_second: Maximum absolute steering change per simulated second in normalized [-1, 1] steering space.

_remarks.enabled: true => initialise the AirSimEnv policy from a pretrained 2D checkpoint instead of random weights.
_remarks.source_policy_path: Path to the 2D .zip policy file (relative to repo root or absolute).
_remarks.freeze_shared_layers: true => freeze all transferred layers so only the mapping-layer first linear adapts. false => fine-tune the full network.
_remarks.mapping_layer_init_gain: Orthogonal init gain for the mapping layer after transfer. 0.1 dampens initial activation mismatch with pre-trained deep layers without killing the gradient signal. 0.01 is too small (near-zero learning); sqrt(2)~1.414 is too large (gradient explosion).

_remarks.use_airsim: Master on/off switch for AirSim bridge usage.
_remarks.ip: AirSim RPC host IP address. Empty string resolves to 127.0.0.1 (localhost).
_remarks.timeout: Connection timeout in seconds. Must be positive; validated by AirSimConfig.
_remarks.max_retries: Maximum connection retry attempts before the bridge gives up. 0 means try once with no retries.
_remarks.health_check_interval: Seconds between periodic health-check pings to the AirSim RPC server. Must be positive.
_remarks.csv_log_path: Optional CSV path for AirSim bridge low-level telemetry. Empty string disables CSV logging.
_remarks.save_slot: UE5 save slot loaded during the one-shot world reload on training/visualization startup.
_remarks.simulation_speed: Base UE5 speed multiplier used by the visualization path and as the fallback when training does not override it.
